groups.place: THE NEW WAR, THEN JADE SHADOWS

groups.activity: clear the mission; throw Boosted Ionic Charges up the elevator
groups.meta: ~5% blueprint drop per completion; pity currency also drops every run
groups.mode: solo or premade; pubs often ignore the elevator objective
conditions: The Extraction Capsule is invulnerable during the whole elevator ascent. It is not a defense objective, so time spent fighting there is time the elevator isn't moving.
Throw Boosted Ionic Charges (two marker outlines) the instant you get them; the speed boost extends the timer (up to ~50s) rather than stacking in magnitude, so hoarding one wastes it.
Do the optional Sister of Parvos objective (3 Sister Beacons in the shaft) every run; it adds 5-10 more motes (8-10 Steel Path) for the same mission.
bonuses: Every completion pays 11-13 Vestigial Motes (16-18 Steel Path) even without the blueprint drop, banking toward the 300-mote pity buy.
Steel Path pays roughly 1.5x motes and guarantees the Sister's arcane drop; Acolytes don't spawn here so there's no added risk.

disclosures.title: loot frames don't work here
disclosures.body: Nekros Desecrate, Khora and Atlas Ore Gaze affected the Ascension Sister for about two days after launch; Hotfix 36.0.3 (2024-06-20) patched it out. Resource Boosters, Resource Drop Chance Boosters, Drop Chance Blessings and Retriever have no effect on Vestigial Motes; they still affect Steel Essence.

disclosures.title: squad matters more than build
disclosures.body: Run times are 7-10 minutes pugging, 5-6 with a coordinated squad that actually throws charges, versus 3-4 with a dedicated lockdown build (e.g. Banshee with Silence and a subsumed Gloom). The loudest recurring complaint is teammates treating the elevator like a defense objective, so solo or a premade beats a pub here.
